statements.status_notes: libexpat before 2.8.3 treats low surrogates like high surrogates in its *_toUtf16 conversion functions, which leads to an out-of-bounds read and a resulting infinite loop. Upstream fixed it in libexpat 2.8.3 with https://github.com/libexpat/libexpat/pull/1296 (fix commit https://github.com/libexpat/libexpat/commit/8886826d70359864b5004f21b73749898ec0a634); see https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-72522. Debian fixed it in trixie with expat 2.8.3-1~deb13u1 (DSA-6446-1). Checked libexpat.so and the Debian changelog in the libexpat1 package of every published DHI Debian 13 expat build on amd64 and arm64: the builds of Debian's 2.8.3-1~deb13u1 and 2.9.0-1~deb13u1 report libexpat 2.8.3 and 2.9.0 and their changelog lists CVE-2026-72522; the build of 2.8.2-1~deb13u1 reports libexpat 2.8.2 and its changelog does not list it; the older builds report libexpat 2.7.1.

Debian fixed it in trixie with expat 2.8.3-1~deb13u1 (DSA-6446-1). Checked libexpat.so and the Debian changelog in the libexpat1 package of every published DHI Debian 13 expat build on amd64 and arm64: the builds of Debian's 2.8.3-1~deb13u1 and 2.9.0-1~deb13u1 report libexpat 2.8.3 and 2.9.0 and their changelog lists CVE-2026-72522; the build of 2.8.2-1~deb13u1 reports libexpat 2.8.2 and its changelog does not list it; the older builds report libexpat 2.7.1.
